n773aa6404d.headline: Financial sector: awaiting Mauritius' removal from the blacklist
n773aa6404d.summary: Mauritius' financial sector recovery depends on the country's removal from the EU blacklist, which could be influenced by Covid-19 vaccine progress.
n773aa6404d.why: Being on the EU blacklist restricts Mauritius' access to international financial markets and investment.
